title: Sales Manager
meta_desc: Sales Manager job in Gżira, Malta: lead MG new-car sales and the showroom for an established automotive group. Maltese and English. Apply now.
experience: Previous experience in sales management, preferably within the automotive industry
qualifications: Diploma-level education; previous sales management experience, preferably automotive; fluency in Maltese and English; Microsoft Office
about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established automotive group in Malta, for a confident and results-driven MG Sales Manager to join its team in Gżira.

You will promote the MG brand, build customer relationships, manage vehicle sales from first enquiry to handover and keep the showroom running to company and franchise standards. You will also help with launches, motor fairs, sales budgets and stock orders.

The role suits a motivated sales professional with strong leadership abilities and a passion for the automotive industry. It is full-time and on-site, with a competitive salary, health insurance and local and international training.
responsibilities: Promote the MG brand, drive vehicle sales and increase brand awareness among potential customers
Build and maintain strong customer relationships and guide customers through the sales process
Present vehicle models, explain features and technology, and arrange test drives
Manage vehicle sales documentation and coordinate deposits and customer payments
Coordinate vehicle preparation and delivery, making sure customers understand their vehicle's features and controls
Follow up enquiries, provide ongoing assistance and handle complaints professionally
Oversee daily showroom presentation so vehicles and facilities meet the required standards
Ensure compliance with franchise standards and stay current on vehicle specifications and new technologies
Attend local and international product training and share the knowledge with the sales team
Support new vehicle launches, motor fairs and promotional events
Monitor market trends, competitor activity, pricing and marketing to spot sales growth opportunities
Assist the Brand Manager and General Manager with sales budgets, business and marketing plans, sales reports and vehicle stock orders
Take part in meetings with franchise representatives and support quality audits
requirements: Previous experience in sales management, preferably within the automotive industry
A strong sales-oriented mindset with the ability to attract customers and identify business opportunities
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Fluency in Maltese and English, spoken and written
A confident, reliable and outgoing personality with strong interpersonal and organisational skills
Ability to work towards sales targets while keeping high customer service standards
offer: The opportunity to develop your career within an established automotive group
preferred: Sales management experience within the automotive industry
company: Our client is a well-established automotive group in Malta that represents the MG brand, with its showroom team in Gżira.
location_text: Gżira sits on the Marsamxett Harbour front between Sliema and Msida, one of the busiest stretches of Malta's north-east coast, with steady footfall and frequent bus connections across the island.
